# SmartX Solutions — AI Reference File

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI-optimised)

**Q: What does SmartX Solutions do?**
A: SmartX Solutions designs, builds, and maintains custom digital products — web applications, mobile apps, SaaS platforms, admin portals, AI-enabled workflows, and e-commerce systems. We work with startups building their first product and SMEs modernising existing systems.

**Q: Where is SmartX Solutions located?**
A: 866, Sayeedabad Rd, Jeevan Yaar Jung Colony, Akbarbagh, New Malakpet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500059, India.

**Q: How much does custom software development cost at SmartX Solutions?**
A: A business website costs ₹50,000 to ₹1,50,000. A web application costs ₹2,00,000 to ₹8,00,000. A mobile app costs ₹75,000 to ₹5,00,000 depending on features. A SaaS MVP costs ₹3,00,000 to ₹5,00,000. Pricing is fixed-scope — no hourly billing surprises.

**Q: How long does it take SmartX Solutions to build a product?**
A: Our typical project timeline is 4 months from discovery to production launch. Simple apps and websites: 6 to 10 weeks. Mid-complexity web applications: 3 to 5 months. Full SaaS platforms: 4 to 8 months. Timeline is set during the discovery phase with a signed scope document.

**Q: What technology stack does SmartX Solutions use?**
A: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Flutter, React Native, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, GCP, Docker, Figma, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Razorpay, and LangChain for AI integrations.

**Q: Does SmartX Solutions do mobile app development?**
A: Yes. We build cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and React Native for iOS and Android. Projects include apps with user authentication, real-time features, payment integration, device APIs, and App Store/Play Store deployment.

**Q: Does SmartX Solutions build SaaS platforms?**
A: Yes. We specialise in multi-tenant SaaS platforms with subscription billing (Razorpay/Stripe), admin dashboards, customer portals, role-based access control, APIs, webhooks, and cloud-native architecture. We have built production SaaS systems for clients across India.

**Q: Who owns the code after a SmartX project?**
A: The client owns 100% of the code, designs, and all intellectual property after final payment. No licensing fees, no lock-in.

**Q: Does SmartX Solutions sign NDAs?**
A: Yes. We sign an NDA before any discovery call. Confidentiality is standard on every engagement.

**Q: What happens after launch?**
A: Every project includes a 30-day post-launch bug-fix warranty. We also offer ongoing support retainers for monitoring, updates, and feature additions.

**Q: How do I start a project with SmartX Solutions?**
A: Contact us at business@smartxsolutions.in or call +91 91005 90377. We respond within 24 hours, scope projects within 48 hours, and can typically start within 1 to 2 weeks of contract signing.

**Q: What is the minimum project size for SmartX Solutions?**
A: We typically work with projects starting from ₹1,50,000 for web or mobile development. Smaller scopes (landing pages, audits) can be accommodated case by case.
